items.title: Salesforce Expands Agentforce With a New Portfolio of AI Agents Built for High-Value Work
items.excerpt: Salesforce introduced job-ready Agentforce agents plus a long-horizon runtime that preserves memory and durable execution across days or weeks. Multi-Agent Orchestration is GA; Agent Optimizer is planned for October 2026. Customer outcome figures are vendor-reported.
items.query: enterprise AI agent long-horizon workflow September 14 2026 official

items.title: The OneTrust 2026 AI-Ready Governance Survey Report
items.category: 企業AI・ガバナンス調査
items.excerpt: OneTrust and Sapio surveyed 1,200 senior decision-makers in eight markets in June–July 2026. 87% encourage agent use but 47% report clear governance; 86% experienced at least one measured AI-related incident in the prior year. Respondents worked at organizations with at least $100M revenue.
items.query: AI governance adoption survey September 2026 agents incidents

items.title: What is Bolt Forge? Open-source AI building on Bolt.new
items.category: オープンウェイト・コーディングエージェント
items.excerpt: Bolt launched Forge as an opt-in research-preview coding agent using open models including GLM 5.3 Flash, GLM 5.3, Kimi K3 and DeepSeek v4 Pro. Opted-in anonymized build sessions are shared with Arcee AI to train future open-weight models; Bolt's 92.2/101 benchmark comparison is self-reported.
items.query: open model coding agent training data September 14 2026

items.title: Agentic AI Foundation Launches MCPA Certification to Validate MCP Expertise
items.excerpt: AAIF launched the Model Context Protocol Associate (MCPA), described as the first official MCP certification. The vendor-neutral exam covers MCP fundamentals, architecture/components, interactions/execution, security/governance, and use cases/ecosystem and is administered through Linux Foundation training.
items.query: MCP certification Agentic AI Foundation September 14 2026

items.title: Detecting and countering misuse of AI: September 2026
items.excerpt: Anthropic reports disruptions from Dec. 2025–Aug. 2026 across cyber, influence, surveillance, scams, biological misuse, conventional weapons and illicit distillation. The report includes attributed allegations about state-linked and commercial actors; these are Anthropic findings, not independently established here.
items.query: Anthropic threat intelligence September 2026 AI misuse agents

items.title: Modernizing complex legacy code with AI agents
items.category: AIエージェント・コーディング・Scientific Software
items.excerpt: Mistral describes migrating the first 40,000 lines of a 300,000-line Fortran 77 reservoir simulator to C++. The team built a numerical-parity harness, used more than 100 agents for documentation, and found structured coder/tester/reviewer workflows with human checkpoints more effective than full autonomy.
items.query: AI agents Fortran legacy scientific code modernization September 2026

items.title: Palantir and Fujitsu Deepen Partnership to Advance Enterprise AI Transformation
items.category: 企業AI・製造・データ基盤
items.excerpt: Fujitsu became a Global FDE Partner for Palantir AIP and Foundry. Fujitsu says a supply-chain resilience deployment at a Japanese manufacturer integrates data across more than 3,000 suppliers and 18 factories while retaining governed workflows, access controls and customer-controlled deployment.
items.query: Japan enterprise AI manufacturing governed data September 2026 Fujitsu Palantir

items.title: NVIDIA and Palantir Bring Sovereign Intelligence to Critical Supply Chains
items.category: 企業AI・サプライチェーン・オープンモデル
items.excerpt: NVIDIA and Palantir announced a stack combining Palantir Foundry/AIP/Ontology with custom NVIDIA Nemotron open models, first deployed in NVIDIA's own supply chain. The reference architecture targets cloud or on-premises operation with customer control of proprietary data.
items.query: sovereign enterprise AI supply chain open model September 2026

items.title: Wipro's AI push frees capacity equivalent to 20,000 workers, CTO says
items.excerpt: Wipro's CTO told Reuters that AI productivity gains freed capacity equivalent to about 20,000 workers, who were redeployed rather than removed. Wipro had about 243,000 employees in June and says more than 100,000 staff received advanced AI training; the firm has not disclosed AI revenue.
items.query: enterprise AI workforce productivity India September 2026 Wipro

items.title: Agnes-3.0-Flash Preview
items.category: オープンウェイト・最新AIモデル
items.excerpt: The open Agnes-3.0-Flash Preview checkpoint is Apache-2.0, 33B parameters and 262,144-token context, with text/image/video input and tool calling. Its model card explicitly distinguishes the preview weights from the newer production/API checkpoint and warns against attributing API benchmarks to the preview.
items.query: open weight multimodal model September 2026 Agnes 3.0 Flash

items.title: YuE2-3B
items.category: オープンウェイト・生成AI
items.excerpt: YuE2-3B is an open music-generation model that separates symbolic score planning from audio rendering and supports conversational/agentic editing. Public release materials list roughly 3.6B parameters, 48 kHz stereo output and CC BY-NC 4.0 weights; reported quality comparisons are project benchmarks.
items.query: open source model release September 2026 symbolic planning agentic editing

items.title: Cloudera and Mistral Partner to Bring Specialized, Sovereign Intelligence to Enterprise Data
items.category: 企業AI・オープンモデル・データ基盤
items.excerpt: Mistral and Cloudera announced integration work for regulated enterprise deployments across on-premises and cloud environments, emphasizing model/data control and sovereign operation. The partnership targets mission-critical data estates rather than public-chat use cases.
items.query: Europe sovereign enterprise AI open models data September 2026

items.title: LG unveils expert AI for manufacturing, science and finance
items.excerpt: LG AI Research unveiled manufacturing AI for tabular state prediction and autonomous inspection, EXAONE Discovery for materials design/synthesis-result prediction, and an autonomous experimentation framework. LG says its research has addressed more than 100 industrial challenge cases.
items.query: Korea manufacturing scientific AI materials autonomous inspection September 14 2026

items.title: Hexagon releases next-generation OPTIV S 4.4.3 Optical CMM at IMTS
items.excerpt: Hexagon launched the next-generation OPTIV S optical CMM for high-value component inspection, with phased AI-assisted measurement capabilities planned through 2026–2027. The system combines vision, tactile and multisensor measurement and is positioned for aerospace and precision manufacturing.
items.query: AI-assisted metrology manufacturing September 2026 Hexagon CMM

items.title: Large language model-enabled automated data extraction for concrete materials informatics
items.category: Scientific AI・材料インフォマティクス
items.excerpt: The peer-reviewed pipeline extracts composition–process–property data from materials literature. The authors report F1 up to 0.98 and nearly 9,000 records with over 100 attributes from a corpus screened from more than 27,000 publications, forming an open blended-cement concrete database.
items.query: scientific AI materials data extraction September 14 2026 LLM

items.title: Benchmark Dataset of Vibrational Signals for Artificial Intelligence Applications in Mechanical Systems
items.excerpt: Scientific Data published a benchmark of 7,000 vibration signals from a modular mechanical transmission system with induced faults in gears, V-belts and roller chains. The dataset is intended for AI-based fault diagnosis and condition-monitoring research.
items.query: mechanical systems AI benchmark dataset vibration September 14 2026

items.title: Steel surface small defect target detection based on improved YOLOv8
items.excerpt: The peer-reviewed study proposes an improved YOLOv8 network for small steel-surface defect detection and evaluates it on NEU-DET. It targets inspection precision for small defects in manufacturing imagery rather than general-purpose vision.
items.query: manufacturing AI defect detection September 14 2026 materials

items.title: Light-to-token conversion using MoS2
items.excerpt: A Nature Electronics research highlight describes a 32×32 MoS2 phototransistor array plus FPGA-controlled circuits that perform light detection, patching and vector encoding in the analog domain. The highlighted work reports 87.3% modified-CIFAR-10 accuracy and >14× lower tokenizer energy than a digital implementation.
items.query: edge AI analog vision transformer materials September 14 2026

items.title: Fujitsu launches made-in-Japan next-generation CPU FUJITSU-MONAKA and Fujitsu MONAKA Server for sovereign AI infrastructure
items.excerpt: Fujitsu announced global sales of FUJITSU-MONAKA and the Japan-made MONAKA Server from November 2026. The company positions its Japan-developed 2nm 3D-stacked CPU for AI inference, data-center, enterprise and academic/HPC workloads in Japan and Europe.
items.query: Japan AI inference HPC sovereign infrastructure September 14 2026 MONAKA

items.title: Cornelis to Build Scale-Up Interconnect Using UALink and ESUN
items.excerpt: Cornelis announced an Active Compute Fabric roadmap spanning scale-up and scale-out networking using UALink/ESUN and Ultra Ethernet-related technologies. Its official architecture page describes planned in-network collective, KV-cache and MoE-routing acceleration; performance claims remain vendor-reported.
items.query: HPC AI interconnect inference infrastructure September 14 2026

items.title: 46.9% of Enterprises Report AI Spend Over Budget in 2H 2026
items.excerpt: Futurum surveyed 1,636 global enterprise technology decision-makers. 46.9% report AI spend above plan versus 5.6% below; among 767 over-plan organizations, 47.6% seek more budget, 43.3% absorb the overrun and 17.2% pause or reduce the initiative.
items.query: AI spending enterprise survey September 2026 budget ROI

items.title: Gartner Survey Finds Only 22% of Organizations Have Successfully Scaled AI Across Multiple Business Units
items.excerpt: Gartner surveyed 1,303 respondents from organizations with at least $50M annual revenue during Jan–Apr 2026. 22% report AI scaled across multiple business units or an AI-first approach; 85% of functional leaders plan increased 2026 spending, while about 11% do not know their function's 2025 AI spend.
items.query: enterprise AI scaling ROI survey September 2026 Gartner

items.title: India’s enterprise AI investment surges 119% but only 22% have governance to match
items.excerpt: ServiceNow's Enterprise AI Maturity Index 2026 reports Indian enterprise AI investment up 119% year over year versus 110% globally, while 22% of surveyed Indian enterprises have AI testing, auditing and risk-assessment processes in place. Figures are vendor-sponsored research.
items.query: India enterprise AI adoption governance survey September 2026 ServiceNow

items.title: India’s AI advantage is human: Microsoft Work Trend Index 2026
items.excerpt: Microsoft's 2026 Work Trend Index combines a survey of 20,000 AI users across ten markets with anonymized Microsoft 365 signals. In the India cut, 32% of AI users qualify as 'Frontier Professionals' versus 16% globally; 63% prioritize AI-output quality control and 59% critical thinking.
items.query: AI workforce productivity survey India September 2026 Microsoft

items.title: Gartner Survey Finds 93% of Audit Functions Use AI, but 60% Lack a Formal Strategy
items.excerpt: A Gartner May 2026 webinar poll of 161 chief audit executives found 93% report some AI use, while 60% lack a formal AI strategy and 54% have not started measuring ROI. Only 15% report defined, organized AI use cases; much use remains individual and ad hoc.
items.query: AI adoption ROI function survey September 2026 audit Gartner
